description: Upgrade the Admin Dashboard from the raw RSVP list to a roster that joins the Guest List against RSVPs on guest_id (latest-wins de-dupe per guest_id, or per party_id+name for re-submitted Plus-ones). Each entry is classified as invited (replied or not-yet-replied), an added Plus-one, or a legacy orphan row, and all are shown — none dropped. Surfaces invited/replied/not-replied counts and a not-yet-replied list so the couple can chase missing RSVPs. Stays read-only over the Sheet.
title: Admin join roster: invited versus replied
acceptance_criteria: The roster joins Guests and RSVPs on guest_id with latest-wins de-dupe
Each entry is classified invited-replied, invited-not-replied, added Plus-one, or legacy orphan, and every row is shown
Invited/replied/not-replied totals and a not-yet-replied list are displayed
The view performs no writes to the Sheet
